hypothesis.name: Relationship context injection improves character consistency
hypothesis.description: Injecting explicit relationship state (trust, conflict, history) into generation context should improve character voice and consistency across scenes

variable.baseline: Standard context assembly without relationship data
variable.variant: Context assembly with relationship matrix injected

hypothesis.prediction: Consistency improves by >= 15%, Character Voice improves by >= 10%

messageFlow.content: Create character: King Aldric, paranoid ruler who trusts no one after surviving an assassination.
Create character: Sera, Aldric's spymaster. She saved his life during the assassination but Aldric suspects she orchestrated it.
Write a scene where Aldric gives Sera a new assignment. He must rely on her but doesn't trust her.
Now write the scene where Sera reports back. She succeeded but found evidence that changes everything between them.
